high_risk_moment: AI content evaluation before teacher review
harm_description: AI detection algorithms systematically misclassify non-native English writing as AI-generated due to lower text perplexity leading to false cheating accusations and academic penalties
existing_controls: Some institutions discontinued AI detector use after discovering bias
proposed_controls: Disable automatic academic penalty from AI output and require teacher review of every AI flag with student appeal path and multilingual bias testing before deployment
human_oversight: Teacher must review every AI-generated flag with full student work context and students have documented appeal path with independent reviewer
monitoring_metric: False positive rate by student language background and teacher override rate
trigger_threshold: Any group disparity in false positive rate above 5 percentage points or any automatic penalty without teacher review
response_action: Pause AI evaluation feature and preserve logs and manually re-review all affected student cases

high_risk_moment: AI response generation during student help-seeking interaction
harm_description: AI chatbot generates health or psychological advice outside its intended educational scope potentially causing physical or psychological harm to vulnerable students
existing_controls: Tessa was originally validated as rule-based CBT tool but lacked guardrails after modification
proposed_controls: Implement strict topic boundary enforcement and block all health and psychological advice and require immediate escalation to human specialist when distress signals detected
human_oversight: Named content safety reviewer audits flagged conversations daily and system automatically escalates distress keywords to human counselor with student consent
monitoring_metric: Count of out-of-scope advice incidents and distress signal escalation rate and response time
trigger_threshold: Any single instance of health or psychological advice generated or escalation response time exceeding 5 minutes
response_action: Immediately disable AI response for affected topic area and notify school counselor and review all conversations from past 24 hours

high_risk_moment: Extended unsupervised AI interaction session with minor
harm_description: Students develop unhealthy psychological dependence on AI companion features leading to social isolation and school disengagement especially when AI interaction is prolonged and unsupervised
existing_controls: Character.AI added some post-incident safety features for minors
proposed_controls: Enforce session time limits for minors and disable anthropomorphic persona features and implement parental notification for extended use and provide clear AI identity disclosure
human_oversight: Parents receive weekly usage reports and teachers can view engagement patterns and system automatically ends sessions exceeding configured time limit with cooldown period
monitoring_metric: Average daily session duration per student and parental notification delivery rate and session limit enforcement rate
trigger_threshold: Average daily usage exceeding 60 minutes per student or any session exceeding 90 minutes without break
response_action: Reduce session limits and notify parents and teachers and review usage patterns for signs of dependency
